therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: dopaminergic neurotransmission modulation / antipsychotic symptom suppression
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with recent-onset schizophrenia or schizophreniform disorder
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Time to first treatment failure (Part 2); Change from baseline in MCCB composite score (Part 3)

results.effect_size: Part 2: median time to treatment failure not reached in either arm; Part 3 EDP: MCCB change PP→PP +1.6 vs OAP→OAP +3.2 T-score; Part 3 Disease Modification: MCCB change PP→PP -0.7, OAP→PP -0.2, OAP→OAP +0.5 T-score
biomarker_changes: Part 2: Change in adjusted ICM fraction PP arm -0.001 vs OAP arm -0.004 (ratio)
Part 3 EDP: Change in adjusted ICM fraction PP→PP -0.001 vs OAP→OAP -0.003
Part 3 Disease Modification: Change in adjusted ICM fraction PP→PP -0.7, OAP→PP -0.2, OAP→OAP +0.5 (LS mean ratio)
subgroup_findings: Part 2 CRDPSS Hallucinations: PP improved 29, worsened 7; OAP improved 73, worsened 19
Part 2 CRDPSS Delusions: PP improved 23, worsened 10; OAP improved 70, worsened 20
Part 2 CRDPSS Negative Symptoms: PP improved 16, worsened 17; OAP improved 61, worsened 25
Part 3 EDP CRDPSS Negative Symptoms: PP→PP improved 11, worsened 11; OAP→OAP improved 22, worsened 4
Part 3 EDP CRDPSS Mania: PP→PP worsened 0; OAP→OAP worsened 3
safety_signals: Completed suicide in Part 3 OAP→PP arm (1/57)
Homicidal ideation SAE in Part 2 PP arm (1/78)
Depressed mood SAE in Part 2 PP arm (1/78)
Agitation SAE in Part 2 PP arm (1/78)
Catatonia SAE in Part 3 OAP→OAP arm (1/63)
Overdose SAE in Part 1 run-in (1/273) and Part 2 OAP (1/157)

dose_info.dose: PP1M: 234 mg (Day 1), 156 mg (Day 8), then 78–234 mg monthly; PP3M: 3.5× final PP1M dose q12 weeks
dose_info.schedule: PP1M: Day 1, Day 8, then monthly (Days 36, 64, 92); PP3M: once every 12 weeks
dose_info.dose_modifications: Dose increased based on Investigator's discretion for PP3M

context.comparator: oral antipsychotics (aripiprazole, haloperidol, olanzapine, oral paliperidone ER, perphenazine, quetiapine, oral risperidone)
context.duration: Part 1: run-in; Part 2: 9 months; Part 3: up to 18 months
